components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--color-text); color: #fff; padding: 0.65rem 1.4rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-text); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); font: 500 0.8125rem var(--font-sans); cursor: pointer; transition: transform var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out), box-shadow var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out), background var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out), color var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: transparent; color: var(--color-text); transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-text); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Bordered secondary action with the same tactile response.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: var(--color-text); padding: 0.65rem 1.4rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-border-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); font: 500 0.8125rem var(--font-sans); cursor: pointer; transition: transform var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out), box-shadow var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out), border-color var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--color-text); transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-text); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Tag
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem; border-radius: var(--radius-full); background: var(--color-accent-soft); color: var(--color-text); font: 500 0.6875rem var(--font-sans); }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.css: .ds-nav-link { position: relative; display: inline-block; padding: 0.375rem 0; color: var(--color-text-muted); font: 500 0.8125rem var(--font-sans); letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-decoration: none; transition: color var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out); } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { color: var(--color-text); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-text); outline-offset: 4px; }

narrative.overview: A professional, creative portfolio with confident hierarchy, purposeful imagery, and lightly layered surfaces. Creative moments demonstrate judgment and make complex systems legible.

rules.name: The Project Color Rule
rules.body: Keep the shell restrained so each case study can carry its own palette.

rules.name: The Signature Type Rule
rules.body: Use the serif sparingly. It is a signature, not a default treatment for every heading.

rules.name: The Light Layer Rule
rules.body: Use one quiet layer before reaching for glass, blur, or a larger shadow.

dos: Do prioritize work samples and project detail as evidence.
Do use confident hierarchy for fast scanning.
Do verify WCAG 2.2 AA and reduced-motion fallbacks.
donts: Don't make this look like an AI slop website.
Don't use repetitive card grids as a default composition.
Don't use gratuitous glassmorphism, purple or blue gradients, or decorative effects without purpose.
Don't repeat tiny uppercase labels or numbered markers as automatic scaffolding.
